FN-YMDWYN2-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 313
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Rodger M. Smitherman
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/16/2025
Senate Bill 313 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama 21st Century Fund
(Fund) by authorizing these funds when no longer needed to pay debt obligations to: (1) be used
to pay for the purposes authorized pursuant to legislation enacted establishing the Alabama
Energy Infrastructure Bank and the Strategic Energy Infrastructure Development Fund, during
the 2025 Regular Session, or special session held prior to October 1, 2025; (2) provide for the
transfer of $50 million from the Fund to the Bank for fiscal year 2026 to be used for the
authorized purposes; and (3) provide for the transfer of $10 million from the Fund to the
Alabama Incentives Financing Authority to pay for project and project costs for fiscal year 2026.
As of March 2025, the balance in the Alabama 21st Century Fund was $74 million.
.

FN-YMDWYN2-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 313
Committee: Economic Development and Tourism Sponsor: Senator Rodger M. Smitherman
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/29/2025
Senate Bill 313 as passed the Senate would transfer the following amounts from the Alabama
21st Century Fund to entities listed for fiscal year 2025:
1. $50 million to the Alabama Energy Infrastructure Bank State for support of the Strategic
Energy Infrastructure Development Fund;
2. $10 million to the Alabama Incentives Financing Authority to pay for project and project
cost; and
3. $5 million to the Alabama Department of Commerce for the establishment of international
offices, enhancement of rural development strategies, and to cover operational and personnel
costs.
This bill would also require the Alabama 21st Century Authority to maintain no less than 1.3
times the maximum annual debt obligations of the authority obligations, if amounts in the
special fund are no longer needed to pay obligations of the authority, and provide for excess
monies in the Alabama 21st Century Fund to be used by the State Industrial Development
Authority for any authorized purposes of the Alabama Energy Infrastructure Bank.
As of March 2025, the balance in the Alabama 21st Century Fund was $74 million with no debt
obligations.
The provisions of this bill would only be effective if legislation establishing the Alabama
Energy Infrastructure Bank and the Strategic Energy Infrastructure Development Fund is
enacted during the 2025 Regular Session or a special session held prior to October 1, 2025.
